note: Every UTF-8 scalar of `sample` is delivered one byte at a time. `output` cases print the bytes from the child with a pause between them, so the daemon reads each byte in its own pty read and the terminal must reassemble the scalar; `peek --plain` must equal `expectPlain` and the DATA frames an attached client collects must concatenate to the sample bytes. `input` cases send each byte in its own DATA frame to a session running `cat` (echo on); the echoed screen must show the sample. Node decodes each inbound DATA payload as a separate UTF-8 string, so a scalar split across frames is mangled there (decision 0001); those cases carry `node: "mangled"`.
